questions.prompt: Who is the primary reviewer for pull requests modifying the internal compiler crates that packages/next/server depends on?
questions.whyVectorWinsOrLoses: VECTOR RAG LOSES: Chunks mention 'packages/next/server' and 'packages/next-swc' in different files, but cosine similarity loses the 3-hop directional DEPENDS_ON relationship.

vector_rag.label: Naive Chunk + Vector RAG
vector_rag.outcomeNotes: Retrieved 5 disparate chunks; hallucinates generic maintainer due to lost relational graph link.

bm25_text.label: BM25 / Full-Text Search
bm25_text.outcomeNotes: Matched keywords 'compiler' and 'packages/next/server', but lacks topology awareness.

helix_hybrid.label: Helix Hybrid (Vector Seed + Graph)
helix_hybrid.outcomeNotes: Vector seed identifies relevant module entrypoint; FalkorDB traverses 3 hops to verified reviewers.

questions.prompt: What is the active default bundler for Next.js production builds, and what architectural decision superseded Webpack?
questions.whyVectorWinsOrLoses: VECTOR RAG LOSES: Retrieves obsolete Webpack documentation chunks with high semantic similarity, confusing obsolete architecture with current reality.

vector_rag.label: Naive Chunk + Vector RAG
vector_rag.outcomeNotes: Retrieved both Webpack and Turbopack chunks; fails to distinguish superseded fact from active fact.

bm25_text.label: BM25 / Full-Text Search
bm25_text.outcomeNotes: Keyword frequency favors older Webpack docs due to higher historical occurrence in codebase.

graph_only.label: Helix Graph-Only
graph_only.outcomeNotes: Bitemporal filter WHERE d.validTo = '9999-12-31' filters obsolete ADR-009; selects ADR-031 directly.

helix_hybrid.label: Helix Hybrid (Vector Seed + Graph)
helix_hybrid.outcomeNotes: Vector seed retrieves candidate ADRs; graph supersession edge [:SUPERSEDES] prunes obsolete fact.

questions.prompt: What are some general architectural themes, subjective philosophies, and stylistic design principles emphasized across React Server Components?
questions.groundTruth: Zero bundle size, server-first data co-location, streaming HTML, async/await ergonomics
questions.whyVectorWinsOrLoses: VECTOR RAG WINS: Natural language prose search across descriptive markdown documentation excels at fuzzy conceptual brainstorming where no structured relational edge or foreign key exists in the graph.

vector_rag.label: Naive Chunk + Vector RAG
vector_rag.outcomeNotes: WINNER: Superior conceptual synthesis across natural text paragraphs and architectural RFC prose.

bm25_text.label: BM25 / Full-Text Search
bm25_text.outcomeNotes: Good keyword recall for exact terms, but misses synonymous conceptual nuances.

graph_only.label: Helix Graph-Only
graph_only.outcomeNotes: Graph alone lacks rich prose semantics; only captures discrete entity relationships, missing subjective nuance.

helix_hybrid.label: Helix Hybrid (Vector Seed + Graph)
helix_hybrid.outcomeNotes: Combines Vector prose chunks with graph author provenance. High quality, but Vector alone was already sufficient.

questions.prompt: Which core packages have a Single Point of Failure (Bus Factor = 1) with exactly zero secondary maintainers in CODEOWNERS?
questions.whyVectorWinsOrLoses: VECTOR RAG LOSES: Vector embeddings cannot calculate aggregations or verify absent relationships (negations). It finds 'Sam Ko' near 'packages/font' and assumes normal ownership.

vector_rag.label: Naive Chunk + Vector RAG
vector_rag.outcomeNotes: Cannot prove absence of second owner; hallucinates that team collectively maintains package.

graph_only.label: Helix Graph-Only
graph_only.outcomeNotes: Computes Cypher aggregation: MATCH (p)-[:OWNS]->(m) WITH m, count(p) AS c WHERE c = 1 RETURN m.

helix_hybrid.label: Helix Hybrid (Vector Seed + Graph)
helix_hybrid.outcomeNotes: Graph identifies bus-factor-1 module; vector seed retrieves succession history context.
